mainEntity.name: What is the process for planning a functional layout improvement with a contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process typically begins with an initial consultation where we discuss your goals, needs, and budget. Next, we help develop preliminary design concepts and floor plans, sometimes involving an architect or designer, to visualize the proposed changes. Once a design is approved, we handle permitting, material selection, and scheduling the construction phases. A key part of the planning process is clearly defining your priorities, such as wanting an open-concept kitchen or a more private home office, as this guides the design decisions and helps streamline material choices.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves an initial consultation, design concept development, permitting, material selection, and construction scheduling. Clearly defining your priorities upfront is crucial.
